MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink cameras feel like a useful extension of my earlier door alarm purchase because they add a security capability and work with the Alexa devices I already use.",
    "The external DVD drive matches my practical interest in accessing older media, reflected in my earlier floppy reader purchase.",
    "The larger Echo Show and internal SSD connect to my interests in home devices and storage, though interest alone does not mean I need them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "An older Fire TV Stick or Echo Dot gives me little reason to buy when I already have newer versions; a themed cover does not change that.",
    "The larger Echo displays overlap with the Show 5 and stand I recently bought, so even a relevant device can arrive before I have another need.",
    "Mac-compatible accessory purchases do not imply that I need AirPods, and my recent activity gives me no clear reason to buy a tablet."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be taken as a reason to suggest more Alexa devices, even when they repeat functions I already have.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to be stretched into an interest in tablets and earbuds without a specific task connecting them to my purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already addressed, especially streaming and a small smart display.",
    "I respond to accessories that solve a concrete problem, such as reading older discs or adding cameras, more than to another version of something I own.",
    "Compatibility affects whether I can act on an otherwise appealing recommendation: I would need to check my computer before choosing the internal SSD."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in practical electronics and Alexa devices, but give too little weight to what I already own and what useful capability a purchase would add."
}
